definition: A standardized dataset and evaluation protocol used to measure and compare the performance of different models on a specific task or set of tasks.
details: Benchmarks like GLUE, MMLU, and HumanEval provide common yardsticks for tracking progress in NLP and LLM capabilities, though over-optimization to specific benchmarks (benchmark overfitting) is a recognized concern.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Boil it down and it is this: A standardized dataset and evaluation protocol used to measure and compare the performance of different models on a specific task or set of tasks. Here is why it matters: Benchmarks like GLUE, MMLU, and HumanEval provide common yardsticks for tracking progress in NLP and LLM capabilities, though over-optimization to specific benchmarks (benchmark overfitting) is a recognized concern. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Benchmark.
